dataset_scope: English, single-purpose fictional documents for an initial eight-class text classification workflow. This taxonomy is a proposed project baseline, not an exhaustive definition of user documents.
unknown_policy: Unsupported, ambiguous, unreadable, or mixed-purpose uploads require review. Needs Review is an application decision, not a trained ninth document type.

categories.label: marksheet
categories.definition: A student's assessed performance, including subject-level marks or grades.
categories.boundary_rule: A results table remains a marksheet even when its heading includes the word certificate.

categories.label: educational_certificate
categories.definition: An attestation of an educational qualification or completed course, without a subject-level result statement.
categories.boundary_rule: A qualification award with detailed assessed results should be reviewed if both document purposes are substantial.

categories.label: utility_bill
categories.definition: A provider's request for payment for metered or recurring household utility service.
exclude: proof of a completed utility payment
categories.boundary_rule: A utility bill is classified by its service and billing purpose, even when titled invoice; a payment-only acknowledgement is a receipt.

categories.label: invoice
categories.definition: A seller's itemized request for payment for supplied goods or non-utility services.
categories.boundary_rule: The sample must request payment; a document whose primary purpose is acknowledging settlement is a receipt.

categories.label: receipt
categories.definition: An acknowledgement that money was received for goods, services, fees, or a previous bill.
categories.boundary_rule: Explicit completed payment is essential; a payable amount or due date alone does not establish a receipt.

categories.label: land_record
categories.definition: A parcel-focused record of land identity, area, boundaries, recorded holder, and/or land-use details.
categories.boundary_rule: This initial class covers parcel records, not every property document. Sale deeds and jurisdiction-specific legal forms need separate permitted data and expert labeling.

categories.label: bank_statement
categories.definition: An account-period summary with opening/closing balances and a sequence of account transactions.
include: transaction history statements with running balances
categories.boundary_rule: An account transaction history is a bank statement even when individual rows mention invoices, utilities, or fees.

categories.label: prescription
categories.definition: A clinician-authored medication-order document associated with a patient encounter.
categories.boundary_rule: The present synthetic examples contain fictional medicine placeholders without dosage or treatment instructions. They do not establish coverage of real prescribing language, handwriting, or clinical layouts.
